title: Codex CLI update: codex update, pin, and roll back

facts.fact: Codex CLI release 0.146.1 was published on 5 August 2026.
facts.quote: `0.146.1` published on 5 August 2026, `0.147.0` on 7 August 2026, with alpha builds in between.

facts.fact: As of August 2026, stable Codex CLI releases land every few days and pre-releases land most days.
facts.quote: As of August 2026, stable releases land every few days and pre-releases most days.

facts.fact: Codex CLI configuration in ~/.codex/config.toml survives a binary update.
facts.quote: | `~/.codex/config.toml` | Settings, profiles, MCP servers, feature flags | **Yes** |

facts.fact: Codex CLI cached credentials in ~/.codex/auth.json survive a binary update unless the OS keyring is used.
facts.quote: | `~/.codex/auth.json` | Cached credential, unless you use the OS keyring | **Yes** |

facts.fact: Codex CLI session transcripts in ~/.codex/sessions/ survive a binary update.
The deprecated codex exec --full-auto flag is a compatibility flag that warns, and the guide recommends --sandbox workspace-write instead.
facts.quote: | `codex exec --full-auto` is a deprecated compatibility flag and warns | Use `--sandbox workspace-write` explicitly |

facts.fact: The approval_policy setting "on-failure" is deprecated in Codex CLI.
WSL1 support for Codex CLI ended at Codex 0.115.
facts.quote: | WSL1 support ended at Codex 0.115 | Convert the distro to WSL2, or run natively on Windows |

facts.fact: The Codex CLI Linux sandbox moved to bubblewrap, so Linux hosts need the bubblewrap package installed.
facts.quote: | The Linux sandbox moved to `bubblewrap` | Install the `bubblewrap` package on Linux hosts |

facts.fact: The Codex CLI unattended standalone installer update uses the environment variable CODEX_NON_INTERACTIVE=1.
Homebrew installs Codex as a cask, not a formula, and it is updated with brew upgrade --cask codex.
facts.quote: | Homebrew (macOS) | `brew upgrade --cask codex` | Codex is a cask, not a formula |

facts.fact: The guide states it was checked against OpenAI sources in August 2026.
facts.quote: Checked against OpenAI sources in August 2026.
